items.title: 26.6 Artificial organs (masnoo aaza) mein polymers (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 26.6 with Table 26.2 (PDF 156-157).

blocks.text: Biomedical science (medical science) mein artificial organs (masnoo aaza) banane ke liye polymers bohat ahem hain. Artificial organs insan ke banaye hue devices hain jo jism ke kharab ya bimar hisson ki jagah lete hain ya un ke kaam mein madad dete hain. Jism mein lagne wale polymers ko biocompatible (jism jinhein qubool kar le), mechanically suitable (mazbooti aur lachak mein theek), sterilizable (jaraseem se paak kiye ja sakne wale), durable (der tak chalne wale) aur tunable (zaroorat ke mutabiq badle ja sakne wale) hona chahiye.
Yeh jism ko nuqsan na dein, allergy paida na karein, aur jism ka immune system (bimariyon se bachane wala system) inhein reject (radd) na kare.

In ki mazbooti, lachak (flexibility) ya elasticity us hisse ke mutabiq badli ja sakti hai jis ki jagah yeh lagte hain (maslan khoon ki naliyon ke liye lachakdar, haddiyon ke liye mazboot). Medical science mein mukhtalif polymers ke istemal Table 26.2 mein diye gaye hain.

blocks.caption: Table 26.2 Artificial organs (masnoo aaza) mein polymers
rows: Hamwar satah khoon jamne (clot) se rokti hai; band naliyon ki jagah lagti hain ya un ke gird raasta (bypass) banati hain.
Bohat lachakdar aur der tak chalne wale; khoon jamne se mehfooz hone chahiye.
Nayi jild ugne ke liye dhaancha (scaffold); kuch zakhm bharne ke saath ghul jate hain.
Hamwar, kam friction wali satah jo harkat aasan banaye aur ghisaav bardasht kare.
Bilkul transparent (saaf, aar-paar dikhne wala) aur biocompatible, taa ke nazar wapas aa jaye.

blocks.prompt: PTFE artificial khoon ki naliyon ke liye kyun suitable (theek) hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh biocompatible hai aur is ki hamwar satah khoon jamne (clot) se rokti hai.

items: Medical polymers: biocompatible, theek mazbooti, sterilizable, durable aur tunable.
PTFE/PET naliyan, polyurethane/silicone valves, collagen/PLA jild, UHMWPE jor, PMMA cornea.
